title: GET /api/box/trades and /api/box/trades/open (200)
description: Source: src/box/routes.ts. GET /api/box/trades returns { dbEnabled, open, trades } (open = getOpenPositions(), trades = DB-backed serializeBoxTrade list). GET /api/box/trades/open returns { dbEnabled, open } only. Modelled with trades OPTIONAL so both routes validate against the same schema; both are CLOSED otherwise.
